settings.question: How fast will I see a difference?
settings.answer: Every child is different. Many parents notice settled tummies and better appetites within 1–2 weeks of daily use.*

settings.question: What does it taste like? Will my picky kid take it?
settings.answer: It has a natural raspberry flavour and a bitter blocker to soften the herbal taste. Mixed into orange juice or a berry smoothie, most kids drink it without a fuss. Starting with half a dropper helps too.

settings.question: How do I measure the dose?
settings.answer: Shake well, then fill the dropper to the 1 mL line. That’s one serving. [VERIFY: dropper has 1 mL marking]

settings.question: How long does one bottle last?
settings.answer: One 1 oz (30 mL) bottle holds about 30 servings at 1 mL a day. That covers a full 2–3 week routine with some to spare.

settings.question: Is it safe for my 3-year-old? What about side effects?
settings.answer: ParaPatrol is made and dosed for kids 3 and up, and is not for children under 3. Stop use and talk to your doctor if your child has vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, or any unusual reaction. See the safety section for the full list.

settings.question: Can I use it with other supplements or medication?
settings.answer: If your child takes medication or has a health condition, talk to your pediatrician before use. Bring the bottle along so they can see the full ingredient list.

settings.question: Does it contain alcohol, sugar, or nuts?
settings.answer: No alcohol and no sugar. It is also gluten-free. It does contain tree nut (black walnut), so it is not for kids with a tree nut allergy.
